description: This file defines an Angular service 'UnitService' that manages unit systems, conversions, and related utilities for the application, including handling localization and user preferences.

classes.name: UnitService
classes.description: An Angular service providing unit system management, unit conversion, and localization support.

methods.name: getUnitSystem
methods.description: Returns the current unit system (metric, imperial, hybrid).

methods.name: setUnitSystem
methods.description: Sets the current unit system based on user input or timezone detection.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Retrieves a list of units for a given measure and unit system.

methods.name: getUnitsGroupedByMeasure
methods.description: Returns units grouped by measure, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getUnitInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a specific unit symbol.

methods.name: getDefaultUnit
methods.description: Returns the default unit for a given measure and unit system.

methods.name: geUnitConverter
methods.description: Creates a unit converter function for specified units or mappings.

methods.name: getTargetUnitSymbol
methods.description: Determines the target unit symbol from a mapping or string.

methods.name: convertUnitValue
methods.description: Converts a value between units or using a unit mapping.

methods.name: getUnitSystemByTimezone
methods.description: Infers the unit system based on the user's timezone.
